what: Targa Resources gathers and processes natural gas, mostly from the Permian basin, separates out natural gas liquids, transports them to the Gulf Coast, fractionates them into propane, butane and ethane, and exports them.
customers: Permian oil and gas producers, petrochemical plants, and international buyers of propane and butane.
money: gathering systems and processing plants in the Permian and other basins
NGL pipelines, fractionation and the Galena Park export terminal
moat: Gathering systems physically connected to wells in the Permian, plus its own pipeline to its own fractionators and export dock, so one molecule pays it several times.
risks: Debt of about $20 billion against almost no cash
Volumes depend on Permian drilling activity
Some contracts expose it to commodity price swings
Heavy capital spending on new plants and pipelines
opportunities: Permian gas volumes keep rising as oil production grows
Return on invested capital near 13% is strong for a midstream company
Propane and butane exports to Asia grow with petrochemical demand
watch: Permian inlet volumes and NGL export volumes.
